73 static func decode(bytes: PackedByteArray, request: Dictionary, serial: int) -> Dictionary:
  74 	var result:={"error":&"readback_failed","raw":bytes.duplicate()}
  75 	if bytes.size()!=OUTPUT_BYTES or bytes.decode_u32(0)!=VERSION or bytes.decode_s64(88)!=serial:return result
  76 	result.schema=VERSION
  77 	for key in I64_FIELDS:
